component.name: RomMix
component.summary: Big Picture launcher for a RomM library

description.p: RomMix is a controller-first front end for a self-hosted RomM server. It browses your library the way a console dashboard does, downloads games into your emulator's ROM folder, and launches them.

ul.li: Browse and search your whole RomM library with cover art
Sign in by pairing the device, so no password is typed on a TV
Download games straight into the right system folder
Launch into RetroDECK, EmuDeck, RetroArch, Eden or shadPS4, per platform
Install emulators and BIOS files without leaving the app
Sync save files and save states back to RomM when you quit
Designed for gamescope, handhelds and Steam Big Picture
